items.independentDerivation: 12 = (1/2)(6)(8) sin θ = 24 sin θ, so sin θ = 1/2. Since 0° < θ < 180°, θ = 30° or 150°. The cosine rule gives x² = 6² + 8² − 96 cos θ = 100 ∓ 48√3. The positive lengths are √(100 − 48√3) ≈ 4.11 cm and √(100 + 48√3) ≈ 13.53 cm, respectively. Both angles define valid nondegenerate triangles and exhaust the possibilities.
